title: Rabbi Chanin, Son-in-Law of the Patriarch’s House
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Moed Katan 25a relates that he had no children. He prayed for mercy and had a son. On the day his wife gave birth, he died, and they named his son Chanin after his father.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text places this story at Moed Katan 25b and gives the child’s name as Chanan, חנן. Hyman supplies 25a and Chanin; the location and name-form differences are retained.

The checked digital paragraph is Moed Katan 25b. It names Rabbi Chanin as the father and gives the child’s name as Chanan, חנן. Hyman’s supplied 25a locator and Chanin name for the child remain his source forms; no name or folio has been silently repaired.
